artifacts.name: persistence
notes: Not covered: COM hijacking, AppInit/AppCert DLLs, IFEO debuggers, LSA/authentication packages, drivers, BITS jobs, browser extensions, DLL search-order issues.

artifacts.name: processes
notes: 2 process(es) had limited visibility (no command line or path: protected process or missing elevation). Absence of detail is not absence of activity.
Processes that exited during collection are not listed. A process list is a point-in-time snapshot.

limitations: Live-response collection is not a forensic disk or memory image; volatile state changed while collecting.
The manifest is stored beside the evidence: it detects accidental or naive changes but is not independently tamper-proof. Store a copy of the manifest SHA-256 (or a signed manifest) separately.
Timestamps are normalised to UTC from host-reported values; clock accuracy is not verified. Original local times are retained where relevant.
Inaccessible or unexamined sources are listed in the coverage section; absence of data is not absence of activity, and incomplete collection never means the host is clean.
